status: Four actual Eevee views reviewed; static appearance accepted for this lookdev sample.

findings.front: Complete T pose and feet in frame; visible discrete shade bands on white sleeves, face/neck and hair, with thin brown outline.
findings.quarter: Silhouette, clothing and long hair intact; no new large face-covering black shell seen. Original close bangs/glasses arrangement remains.
findings.back: Braided crown, long curls, clothing and both arms preserved; dense overlapping strands create thin interior contour lines, acceptable in the reviewed static image.
findings.face_front: Both eyes, glasses, mouth and neck readable; no broad black facial shadows or gross hull artifacts. Original atlas highlights and texture soft areas remain.
findings.outline: Conservative thin derived hull; not certified under animation or all angles.

limitations: Source mesh remains dense and unrigged; no retopology, clothing segmentation or game performance optimization performed.
Source atlas baked highlights and shadows remain despite live cel light bands.
Face shading mask is approximate and is not semantic facial segmentation; skeletal deformation not verified.
Native Eevee ShaderToRGB, mask and shadowless outline logic do not automatically transfer as GLB/FBX/Unity shader.
native_blend_hash_note: Native scene editability finishing and final package hashes are handled by the final delivery verification; image hashes here describe reviewed renders.
